source: I want a soccer game with bots to play if there's no one to play with I want spawn to be a field with a world cup trophy in the middle of spawn then I want a shop so you can buy celebrations and dance then I want a goalkeeper to guard the goal. then I want rounds of 32,16 quarter final semi finals and then finals. If there is a tie it goes to penalty shootout up to 5 tries to win. Then I was a crowd around the stadium and hear cheering for the teams I want to have a flag pick between France Spain Portugal Argentina New Zealand America Canada Morocco Cape Verde Brazil England Uruguay Croatia Germany Norway. You can choose between any team and swap at any time not in the middle of gameplay though. then I want a shop so people can buy a flag to play 2,500 for Argentina 2,500 for other countries. You earn 250 in game coins for every win. Everytime you goal 10 coins. I want a cheer for the winner of the final. And a flag of Spain for them winning the 2026 world cup.

answers.ask: Should the stadium read as a real modern World Cup venue, or stylized and cartoonish?
answers.answer: Use a real modern World Cup-style stadium, with a large crowd, national flags, and the Spain 2026 winner presentation.

answers.ask: Is the pitch regulation size with full stands, or a compact arcade-sized pitch?
answers.answer: Use a compact arcade-sized pitch with full stands so rounds are quick and easy to play.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D soccer stadium map styled as a modern World Cup venue, centered on a compact arcade-sized regulation-style pitch with two goals and a goalkeeper positioned at each goal. Full spectator stands tightly surround the field, packed with a large crowd and decorated with national flags representing the selectable teams. At the spawn area, place a World Cup-style trophy as the central landmark, with a nearby shop building or kiosk. Include a finals presentation area featuring Spanish flags and a Spain 2026 winner display.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Sports: this is a soccer match venue with a bounded field, goals, and match play. There is no secondary genre.

### Shape and preset
Use the `field-bounded` shape. It is a compact arcade-sized, regulation-style soccer pitch contained within a complete modern World Cup stadium. Match the Full Stadium preset: full stands and stadium enclosure are central to the requested venue. Add scoring and field-start geometry required by the soccer field.

### Config requirements
`trigger-bounds` is visible painted touchlines and goal lines around the pitch, with an invisible foul/reset perimeter aligned to them. `trigger-scoring` is visible goal frames and nets at both ends, with invisible scoring planes inside each goal. `startpoint-play` is the center-circle kickoff position and associated reset placement. `barrier-perimeter` is the stadium bowl and outer containment wall enclosing field and spectators. `spectator-bleachers` is visible full, tightly packed stepped seating on all sides. `npc-population` provides the visible large crowd occupying those stands. All field markings, goals, enclosure, seating, crowd, trophy, kiosk, flags, and presentation display are visible geometry; only the boundary, scoring, and play-start detections are invisible layout elements.

### Layout components
Place the compact rectangular pitch centrally, with two opposing goals on the short ends and one goalkeeper stationed at each goal. Surround it closely with full grandstands, leaving a narrow sideline circulation strip between pitch and seating. Mount 15 national flag displays around the stadium: France, Spain, Portugal, Argentina, New Zealand, America, Canada, Morocco, Cape Verde, Brazil, England, Uruguay, Croatia, Germany, and Norway. Put the arrival/spawn zone at one end of the stadium concourse, facing a World Cup-style trophy on a central plinth; set a small shop kiosk immediately beside it without obstructing access to the field. Reserve a finals presentation platform on the opposite concourse or behind one goal, with Spanish flags and a prominent Spain 2026 winner display. Use clean turf, crisp white markings, goal nets, modern concrete-and-steel stands, and a continuous outer stadium boundary. Frame the pitch as the center of the composition, with the trophy and presentation areas readable at opposite ends.

### Render order
Use `isometric`: the compact stadium’s visual identity, packed stands, trophy landmark, flags, and winner presentation should lead, while the conventional rectangular pitch remains unambiguous in the derived plan.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium: the playing field is compact for quick rounds, but full stands and concourse landmarks enlarge the venue. Theme is a realistic modern World Cup stadium, festive national colors, dense cheering crowd, and Spain 2026 championship presentation. Use `tiered` for the stepped spectator seating; it adds elevation without overhanging surfaces.
